events.title: The Nekome Demo is LIVE NOW 🔪
events.summary: You’ve watched Vano stab, punch, shoot and generally make life very unpleasant for Nazis - Now it’s your turn!The Nekome: Nazi Hunter demo is officially LIVE NOW on Steam during Steam Next Fest, October 19 – 26. The demo gives you an early taste of Horde of the Reich, an extra game mode coming to Nekome that puts your combat skills to the test across 25 increasingly challenging stages. events.title: Nekome Dev Log #2 - One target, many ways in.​
events.summary: Hello everyone and welcome to the second Dev Log for Nekome: Nazi Hunter! In Log #1 we introduced you to Vano Nastasu, a Romani survivor hunting the monsters responsible for murdering his family. From the trailers and gameplay we’ve released, you know that you’ll be cutting a bloody path through the game - but there are multiple ways to achieve your goals! events.summary: Hey everyone, If you caught the new trailer today, thank you for being here. We’ve got a lot more to share in the months ahead, and this is where we’ll be sharing it. For anyone discovering Nekome for the first time: Nekome: Nazi Hunter is a brutal third-person action game following Vano Nastasu, a Romani survivor hunting the people responsible for destroying his family.
